what: round 4 study sbi (track 2): simulate-to-train on the gliders wind world with 4 hidden parameters (lR, dm_00, ls_00, lh): synthetic-likelihood identification from budgeted Lab data, then level-1 predictors trained on real data vs simulations

identification.method: Gaussian synthetic likelihood on 4 linear-regression summaries per episode (mean over the budget's episodes); cubic emulator + emulator and CV-misfit covariance; importance sampling under the viability prior p_v

offline_calibration.what: held-out design points (uniform on the box), projection + emulator refit on the other 80%, posterior from the point's own first n episodes under a flat box prior
offline_calibration.platform: CPU (this container), deterministic from r4-sbi-002 design_features.npz

conclusions: Identification: Gaussian synthetic likelihood on 4 regression summaries contracts all 4 parameters already at 2 episodes (66 ticks; posterior sd / prior sd 0.17-0.44) and to 0.06-0.12 at 512 episodes; contraction flattens beyond about 128 episodes (emulator misfit floor). Marginal coverage is close to nominal on 8 truths (in90 0.875-1.0) and on 300 held-out design points at n <= 4 (in50 0.50-0.52, in90 0.89-0.90); the joint 90% HPD covers 6/8 truths at n = 128 and 512 (slightly overconfident, n too small to decide). See identification.per_budget, identification.offline_calibration.

Prediction: the net trained on 1,024 simulated episodes at posterior draws matches the net trained at the true parameters at every budget (true - post within +-0.003 OES, |z| <= 1.03), even at 2 episodes. The same net on the real Lab data needs 512 episodes to come within 0.019 OES (z 5.8) and is far worse below (gap post - real 1.04 / 0.52 / 0.22 / 0.10 / 0.019 at 2 / 8 / 32 / 128 / 512 episodes). See prediction.table, prediction.headline_gaps.

Most of the gain is knowing the simulator, not identifying theta: a net trained on prior-predictive simulations (no real data) scores 0.544, equal to real@512 (gap +0.002, z 0.4); identification adds 0.021 OES on top (net true - prior_pred, z 5.7; ridge 0.042, z 7.7); the box-centre plug-in loses 0.091 (net) against the truth. See prediction.extra_gaps, prediction.headline_gaps.
